c74object.name: el.markov~
c74object.description:
el.markov~ is an audio-rate, first-order Markov chain event sequencer. It maintains a state transition probability matrix and maps each state to an arbitrary user-defined value (such as a pitch, frequency, or amplitude). The sequencer can advance automatically according to an internal tempo and metric subdivision clock, or step manually one event at a time via bang messages when manual_override is active. The object outputs the current state's assigned value as a continuous signal from the first outlet, alongside a synchronized phase ramp (0.0 to 1.0) from the second outlet.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (bang / messages): Control inlet. Accepts manual transition triggers (bang), transition matrix rows (event_odds), state values (values), active length (set_length), and clock controls (tempo, subdiv, manual_override).
Outlets
Outlet 1 [Left Outlet] (signal): Event value output. Continuously outputs the value assigned to the currently active Markov state.
Outlet 2 [Right Outlet] (signal): Rhythmic phase sync. Outputs a normalized ramp from 0.0 to 1.0 tracking the active clock subdivision (or a 1.0 impulse when triggered manually).

inlet.description: Receives bang messages to step through states, as well as matrix and clock configuration commands.

outlet.description: Outputs the continuous value associated with the current Markov state.
Normalized phase ramp (0.0 to 1.0) tracking progression through the active rhythmic subdivision.

objarg.name: maximum-event-count
objarg.description: The maximum number of states to allocate in the transition matrix (default: 16, range: 2 to 256).

method.name: bang
method.description: When manual_override is active (set to 1), advances the chain to the next probabilistic state.

method.name: event_odds
method.digest: Set transition weights for a state
method.description: Defines the transition probability row for a specific state. The first number is the source state index (0-indexed), followed by relative weights to all active destination states. The number of weights must match the active event count. Weights are automatically normalized to sum to 1.0.

method.name: manual_override
method.description: When set to 1, automatic clocking is paused and state transitions occur only upon receiving a bang. When set to 0 (default), states advance automatically based on the internal tempo and subdiv clock.

method.name: set_length
method.description: Sets the active number of states used in the Markov chain (range: 1 to maximum allocated count, default: 4).

method.name: subdiv
method.description: Sets the metric subdivision of the beat for automatic clock advancement (range: 1 to 128, default: 1).

method.name: tempo
method.description: Sets the internal sequencer tempo in beats per minute (default: 60.0 BPM).

method.name: values
method.description: Sets the output values associated with each Markov state. The number of values in the list must exactly match the active event count.
